<?php
class AggregateGetOption109 {
    public function __toString(): string {
        echo "T:A:", $GLOBALS['stage'], ";";
        return 'precision';
    }
    public function __destruct() {
        ini_set('precision', 1);
        echo "D:A:", ini_get('precision'), ";";
    }
}
class AggregateGetIterator109 implements Iterator {
    public int $pos = 0;
    public AggregateGetOption109 $name;
    public function __construct() { $this->name = new AggregateGetOption109; }
    public function rewind(): void { echo "W;"; $this->pos = 0; }
    public function valid(): bool { echo "V", $this->pos, ";"; return $this->pos < 1; }
    public function current(): mixed { echo "C", $this->pos, ";"; return $this->name; }
    public function key(): mixed { echo "K", $this->pos, ";"; return $this->pos; }
    public function next(): void {
        echo "N", $this->pos, ";";
        ++$this->pos;
        if ($this->pos === 1) $GLOBALS['stage'] = 'done';
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo "I:", ini_get('precision'), ";"; }
}
class AggregateGetInput109 implements IteratorAggregate {
    public function getIterator(): Traversable {
        echo "G;";
        $it = new AggregateGetIterator109;
        $GLOBALS['watch'] = WeakReference::create($it);
        return $it;
    }
}
$stage = 'walk'; $watch = null;
ini_set('precision', 7);
$aggregate = new AggregateGetInput109;
echo "B;";
$result = ini_get(...$aggregate);
echo "R:", $result, ":", ini_get('precision'), ":", $watch->get() === null ? 1 : 0, ";";
unset($aggregate, $watch);
ini_restore('precision');
echo "E:", ini_get('precision'), ";";
purpose: A borrowed Aggregate returns a fresh initialized Iterator whose copied Stringable precision option retires before ini_get reads live precision.

<?php
class AggregateRestoreOption109 {
    public string $id;
    public string $option;
    public function __construct($id, $option) { $this->id = $id; $this->option = $option; }
    public function __toString(): string {
        echo "T:", $this->id, ":", $GLOBALS['stage'], ";";
        return $this->option;
    }
    public function __destruct() {
        ini_set('precision', 1);
        echo "D:", $this->id, ":", ini_get('precision'), ";";
    }
}
class AggregateRestoreIterator109 implements Iterator {
    public int $pos = 0;
    public function rewind(): void { echo "W;"; $this->pos = 0; }
    public function valid(): bool { echo "V", $this->pos, ";"; return $this->pos < 1; }
    public function current(): mixed { echo "C", $this->pos, ";"; return $GLOBALS['name']; }
    public function key(): mixed {
        echo "K", $this->pos, ";";
        if ($this->pos === 0) {
            $GLOBALS['name'] = new AggregateRestoreOption109('B', 'display_errors');
            $GLOBALS['call'] = ini_get(...);
        }
        return $this->pos;
    }
    public function next(): void {
        echo "N", $this->pos, ";";
        ++$this->pos;
        if ($this->pos === 1) $GLOBALS['stage'] = 'done';
    }
}
class AggregateRestoreInput109 implements IteratorAggregate {
    public function getIterator(): Traversable {
        echo "G;";
        return new AggregateRestoreIterator109;
    }
}
$stage = 'walk';
ini_set('precision', 7);
$name = new AggregateRestoreOption109('A', 'precision');
$aggregate = new AggregateRestoreInput109;
$call = ini_restore(...); $keep = $call;
echo "B;";
$result = $call(...$aggregate);
echo "R:", $result === null ? 1 : 0, ":", ini_get('precision'), ":", $name->id,
    ":", $call('precision'), ":", $keep('precision') === null ? 1 : 0,
    ":", ini_get('precision'), ";";
unset($aggregate, $name, $call, $keep);
ini_restore('precision');
echo "E:", ini_get('precision'), ";";
purpose: A borrowed Aggregate returns a fresh Iterator for a selected first-class ini_restore; key-time option/callable rebinding preserves the original restorer and post-disposal precision restore.
